=== THREE FOLDED FIXES (done first, unblock AC#1 + close a11y gate) ===
FIX#1 (loosen common-routes gate): removed `enabled: hasToken` and the `hasToken &&` from useCommonRoutes.ts isLoading — routes/common is now AllowAnonymous (laneA4b) so a logged-out fresh visitor's GET carries only X-Fleet-Slug (client.ts auto-attaches, B-pwa persists) and no longer 401->redirects. useMyActiveOrder LEFT token-gated (per-customer; logged-out visitor has none). New CustomerHomePage test proves a logged-out render shows route cards and getMyActiveOrder is NOT called.
FIX#2 (real route coords into create): updated CommonRouteDto in client.ts to carry laneA4b's real fields { pickupAddress?, pickupLat?, pickupLng?, dropoffAddress?, dropoffLat?, dropoffLng?, fromZoneId?, toZoneId? } (all optional/nullable — backend sends double?=null for Zone routes). buildRouteOrderRequest now sends route.pickupAddress/pickupLat/pickupLng (no more 0-stub). DROPOFF IS ALL-OR-NOTHING: the backend CreateOrder validator (laneA4b note) rejects a non-null dropoffAddress with null dropoff coords -> 400; so the builder only emits dropoffAddress/Lat/Lng when BOTH dropoff coords are present (pickup-only PointToPoint sends no dropoff). Type-narrowing: CommonRouteDto.pickupLat is number|null|undefined but CreateOrderRequest.pickupLat is required number, so used `?? 0` as a total-type fallback for the never-exercised Zone path (isAddressLocked gates Objednat to PointToPoint) while real P2P coords flow through. Proven at the HEADLINE AC#1 page: RouteOrderPage.test.tsx logged-in-create test now asserts payload.pickupLat/Lng/Address + dropoffLat/Lng equal the real route coords (advisor-flagged: the old test only checked routeId/priceType and would pass with the 0-stub).
F-01 (a11y gate): added dedicated vitest-axe component tests for PassengerStepper.tsx + WhenPicker.tsx (each new interactive component needs its own axe assertion per rules/web-accessibility.md#a11y-gate). Also fixed the stale WhenPicker.tsx doc-comment reference (whenPicker.ts -> whenRules.ts; the pure module was renamed in laneB4b to dodge the Windows case-collision with WhenPicker.tsx).

=== B-custom-order DECISIONS ===
(1) SUGGEST-WHEN-LOGGED-OUT: useSuggest + usePriceQuote are gated on authStorage.getAccessToken()!=null (geo/suggest is CustomerOrStaff, pricing/quote is CustomerOnly). A logged-out visitor gets NO autocomplete dropdown and NO price preview, but CAN type a freeform address, use 'Pouzit moji polohu' (GPS pin), and drag the map pin — so the screen works without auth AND without location permission (spec behavior rule). On Objednat the inline CustomerLoginStep surfaces; after login the dropdown/quote populate. Documented in useSuggest.ts / usePriceQuote.ts xmldoc. (This is the task's 'call suggest only when authed' option, and satisfies AC#1's 'autocomplete + drag still function'.)
(2) GPS-PIN STUB: 'Pouzit moji polohu' -> navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition -> on success drop a pin at the RAW GPS coords and label it 'Moje poloha (GPS)' (designer AC#1 exact string; NOT the task-prose 'Moje poloha'). NO reverse-geocode (no endpoint pre-06) — documented client stub in AddressAutocomplete.tsx. On permission denial a friendly Czech message shows and the input+map stay usable. jsdom has no navigator.geolocation so tests stub getCurrentPosition (success + error callbacks).
(3) PRICE PREVIEW (AC#4): pure priceQuote.ts returns a STRUCTURED discriminated union ({kind:'fixed',priceCzk} | {kind:'estimate',lowCzk,highCzk} | {kind:'unknown'}) — NOT a pre-formatted Czech string — so the i18n-czech-first rule is honored (PriceRangeBadge composes 'Cena {n} Kc - pevna' / 'Odhad {low} - {high}' via useTranslation). interpretQuote widens a degenerate equal band (+20 CZK) so an estimate is NEVER a single exact number. quote 502 -> ApiResponseError -> usePriceQuote surfaces errorKey 'customer.custom.quoteUnavailable' -> 'Cenu nelze spocitat, zavolejte nam'. suggest 200-empty -> 'Zadne navrhy' (the empty-items case, not an error — the backend returns 200-empty on upstream failure).
(4) AC#5 MAPPING for the reviewer: designer AC#5 names priceQuote.test.ts for 'Fixed->pevna'. Per the i18n rule the pure module stays structured, so priceQuote.test.ts proves the RANGE/never-single-number invariant via the union, and the Czech 'pevna'/'Odhad' label assertions live in PriceRangeBadge.test.tsx. Same split intent, two files.
(5) OFFLINE: CustomOrderPage gates canSubmit on useOnlineStatus (mirrors RouteOrderPage's online-gating precedent) rather than wrapping the form in OfflineGate — the always-present 'Zavolat' fallback lives in CustomerLayout (shell), so ordering-disabled-offline + visible phone is satisfied without re-wrapping. A test forces navigator.onLine=false and asserts Objednat is disabled and no order is created.
(6) LEAFLET LAZY: PickupMap (React.lazy -> PickupMapInner) mirrors the driver RideMapStrip/RideMapInner split; collapsed by default; a single draggable pin reports coords via dragend. Verified build: no Leaflet in the custom-order/home chunks.
(7) INLINE-LOGIN FORM PRESERVATION: CustomOrderPage owns ALL form state (pickup/dropoff/passengers/when/note) in local useState and only swaps SubmitButton <-> CustomerLoginStep; the page never unmounts so the chosen pickup survives login. onAuthenticated resumes submit(). Reuses postCreateOrder via useCreateOrder (unwraps { order }); navigates to /c/t/{publicCode}. Router: added lazy /c/order/new (B4b left it a dead nav).

=== NEW TRAPS (CLAUDE.md candidates — NOT staged, staging is web/ only) ===
- theme.colors has NO 'primaryLight' token; option-hover uses theme.colors.background + a primary outline (tsc CS-equivalent TS2339 if you reference a missing token).
- vitest 2's vi.fn<T> takes a SINGLE function-type generic, not the old <Args, Return> pair; use plain typed callbacks (vi.fn((success: PositionCallback) => ...)) to stub geolocation without TS2558/implicit-any.
- AddressAutocomplete is a controlled combobox where the parent echoes value.address back a render late; the input's displayed value MUST be the internal `query` state (synced from value.address via effect), or a fake-timer/real controlled value clobbers each keystroke to a single char and the >=3-char suggest never fires.
- CustomOrderPage.test.tsx needs vi.unstubAllGlobals() in beforeEach: the logged-out test's vi.stubGlobal('navigator',...) leaks into a later vi.spyOn(navigator,'onLine') offline test (test pollution).

Did NOT touch api/** or .claude/state pipeline.json. Staged web/ ONLY (dist/ and test-results/ are gitignored). All new i18n keys in BOTH cs.json + en.json (parity green), formal Czech 'vy'. Money integer CZK via formatCzk (Intl.NumberFormat cs-CZ) at render.
